turns.replyText:
Can you compare your two most popular options and tell me which is better for me?
Our two main tile materials are Melamine and Acrylic, and each offers a unique playing experience depending on what you value most.
Melamine tiles have a heavier, cool, stone-like feel that many players associate with a traditional, classic mahjong experience. They are extremely durable and features rich, crisp engraved artwork, making them an excellent value for frequent, everyday play.
Acrylic tiles offer vibrant colors, modern artistic designs, and layered visual effects (like in our Crystal and Halo collections). They tend to feel lighter in the hand compared to melamine.
For everyday use with a focus on value, classic feel, and long-lasting durability, our Melamine collections (such as the Large tiles in the Destination Collection) are typically the best fit!
